column1: # Memory of a build with code mods (gen_runtime_profile.py profile-modules): <title ID> <key> <value>, key mem_reserve | mem_alias | app_pool.
# The game without mods keeps its profile's numbers (dm/games/<title ID>/game.tsv).
# Pokemon Brilliant Diamond: the profile's 2 GB pool is full with Luminescent Platinum's files when the starter is chosen (MapPhysicalMemory +60 MB refused
# twice at 1.90 GB mapped, then a null read). 3 GB, with the alias region and the reservation 2 GB larger: the game's StandardAllocator takes pool minus used
# of the alias region and Unity's pools need the rest (dm/games/0100000011D90000/README.md: the console's 3.21 GB pool reached +3.90 GB of 4.375 GB)
# Pokemon Shining Pearl: Brilliant Diamond's twin, with the same profile memory and the same Luminescent Platinum (its SP release), so the same numbers. Without them
# a build with Luminescent Platinum 2.2F SP kept the profile's 2 GB pool and 5 GB reservation and crashed on a loading screen with a null read in sdk (AYN
# Thor, 0.1.9: CRASH addr=0 pc=sdk+0x39db4); Brilliant Diamond's own failure without its rows was a null read too. Tested with these rows on someone else's device
